experience.company: Atlantic City Casino & Sports • Peru (Hybrid) • Entertainment, B2C
description: - Co-created the Guest Data Cell, a cross-functional initiative to rebuild the Master Guest table from fragmented on-premise sources into a unified, cloud-native golden record in GCP. Delivered a trusted single source of truth for guest identity, compliance, and omnichannel analytics — despite evolving timelines and shifting business priorities.

- Collaborated with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to define deduplication rules, dimensional models, and transactional logic across online and physical casino channels, ensuring consistency across all customer touchpoints.

- Designed and implemented core ingestion and transformation logic using a Medallion architecture in BigQuery and Dataform, filtering duplicates at source and enforcing data quality through automated checks (nulls, uniqueness, referential integrity).

- Migrated legacy SQL pipelines from data science teams into modular, version-controlled Dataform workflows with CI/CD, refactored complex joins into reusable components, optimized query performance, and reduced pipeline runtime by ~40%.

- Architected cross-cloud ETL pipelines from AWS (SQL Server) to GCP BigQuery using Cloud Functions and micro-batching with Parquet via Cloud Storage, ensuring reliable and cost-efficient data replication.

- Optimized high-velocity data delivery to Firestore by designing Avro-based insertion workflows with dynamic Delta Merge strategies, enabling seamless handling of rapidly changing, high-volume datasets.
- Developed a resilient monitoring system for daily Dataproc and Workflow executions (3x/day), sending alerts to accelerate failure detection and resolution.
- Implemented end-to-end observability by mapping SLIs/SLOs using native BigQuery metadata (INFORMATION_SCHEMA, __TABLES__), eliminating external monitoring tools and reducing observability costs.
- Built a Unified Master Query that binaryizes SLO compliance into pass/fail status, cutting analysis time by ~30% and enabling faster operational decisions.
- Documented end-to-end data lineage from Oracle/Sandbox/BigQuery sources to final reports.
- Engineered ETL/ELT pipelines to migrate historical data from Oracle to BigQuery on GCP, with orchestration and health monitoring via Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow).
- Implemented a scalable layered architecture in GCP: raw data in Cloud Storage (Data Lake) and transformed data in BigQuery (Data Warehouse), with Stored Procedures for optimized querying.
- Translated legacy PL/SQL transformation logic to BigQuery Standard SQL, implemented robust data quality validations.
- Optimized BigQuery performance through strategic partitioning and clustering, reducing slot consumption and lowering compute costs.
- Automated infrastructure provisioning using Terraform (tfvars) and BigQuery schema definitions (JSON), deployed via GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
- Collaborated with analytics teams to deliver SQL views, dashboards (Power BI, Looker Studio), and compliance reports.
- Developed and orchestrated distributed PySpark ETL jobs on AWS EMR (S3, EC2) using Apache Airflow DAGs, translating complex SQL into scalable PySpark code via Jupyter Notebooks.
- Enforced data governance and security policies, ensuring all access complied with information protection standards and role-based controls.
